newsitem.title: Philippines: Manila bourse resumes trading after power outage.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse resumes trading after power outage.

text.p: resumed trading at 11:30 a.m. (0330 GMT) on Friday after power
supply was restored at the bourse, an official of the exchange
A power outage at the Tektite Building housing the PSE
caused trading to stop at 10:15 a.m. (0215 GMT).
The stock exchange official said that trading on Friday will not be extended beyond the usual 12 p.m.local (0400 GMT) close of the session.
The market's main index was down by 38.50 points to 3,066.27 when the power interruption occurred.
At 0345 GMT, the index was off 40.14 points, or 1.29 percent, to 3,064.63.
